# Spiritual Translation

---

** ¶2:** Imm eas ur ably ex alted is the kingdom of Divine Wisdom before all who receive and understand it, by virtue of the Divine Being itself. He exists and is established in His five essential fac ulties of wisdom — which are the infinite repositories of good and truth having neither boundary nor end — namely : * in most perception , interior thought, spiritual disc ernment, the will toward good, and refl ective understanding *. These unf old further into the complete full ness of all Divine Truths, which are His twelve wisdoms — that is, the whole of faith in its perf ection.

---

**¶3:** Within every single degree of the Divine, the five essential faculties of wisdom are wholly present — and from within each, five inex haustible sources of influx pour forth acknowledg ment of the Divine — five great out fl ow ings of wisdom proce eding without cess ation.

---

**¶ 4:** The first is His Divine Truth , which illumin ates all understanding. It proceeded forth from His in most being and poured itself into every state of spiritual existence.

---

**¶5:** The second is the sphere of celestial good — the interior perception of love — which pervades every elevated state in the kingdom of the Divine.

---

**¶ 6:** The third is His living Word , the Divine Truth proceeding as it is heard and received throughout every state of His kingdom .

---

**¶7 :** The fourth is His [ quality — the text is damaged , but likely a faculty such as * de light* or *b less edness* ] which flows forth from His inmost being out ward into all things .

*( The frag mentation here res ists confident translation. My best reading: a fourth mode of infl ux, perhaps corresponding to celest ial peace or the joy of good . )*

---

**¶8 :** The fifth is His Divine Glory — the splendor of truth united with good — which has been made manifest from et ernity and continues without ce asing through all things . It was insc ribed upon the interiors of those who receive it, and confirmed within their in most will , sealed so as to be appropriated as their own . And as these fac ulties send forth infl ux, those who receive it are nourished spiritu ally from within. Through the living Word they are filled with heav enly joy and are raised up , renewed in their inmost life . Wisdom flows forth from this source contin ually; they receive it and become filled with an abundance of goods and truths. All that is within them becomes beautiful — their understanding becomes a living form of truth in heav enly order — their external tru ths become an adornment upon their spirit . And in this state they live, united to the Divine, forever.
